$comment: Not an endpoint. Arq has no remote gateway: no authorization server, no tenant isolation, no grant issuing over the network, no revocation, no abuse controls, no kill switches. arq_get_capabilities reports remote_gateway as unavailable. This file records the shape so the work is not rediscovered later.

$requiredBeforeThisCanExist: An authorization server, with token issuer, audience and resource checks on every request
Project grants minted per subject and tenant, with expiry and revocation that reaches a live connection
A bounded snapshot transfer or an outbound channel from a paired Arq application, so whole projects are never uploaded by default
Rate limits, body limits, concurrency quotas, egress policy and secret redaction
Retention, deletion, export and incident policy for plans and project excerpts
Kill switches for the server, for write requests, and per domain profile, project, tenant and client
